title: Ninoy Aquino Day 2024 under Proclamation 368
content: Under the loaded historical Proclamation No. 368, Ninoy Aquino Day in 2024 was scheduled for 2024-08-21. Source: https://customs.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/2024-01-OCOM-MEMO.pdf (attached proclamation, PDF page 3; signed 11 October 2023; checked 2026-10-09).

metadata.sourceClass: Customs memo with full Proclamation 368 attached on PDF pages 2–4

title: Ninoy Aquino Day 2024 amendment reported by BIR Circular 102-2024
content: BIR Revenue Memorandum Circular 102-2024 reports that Proclamation No. 665 moved Ninoy Aquino Day in 2024 from 2024-08-21 to 2024-08-23. Source: https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/RMC%20No.%20102-2024.pdf (one-page circular dated 16 August 2024, reporting the proclamation issued 15 August; checked 2026-10-09).

metadata.excerpt: Aquino Day from August 21, 2024 (Wednesday) to August 23, 2024 (Friday).
